snippet.title: Spice and Wolf: The Wind that Spans the Sea English Trailer
snippet.description:
"Spice and Wolf: The Wind that Spans the Sea" is the second of two business-dating sims released for the Nintendo DS. Originally only available in Japanese, this is a partially remastered version of the game's trailer, created for the release of the fan-made English translation patch. Press CC for subtitles!

Find out more, and grab the download here: https://agtteam.net/holo2

Fancy getting involved with our mission to bring out more awesome anime games in English? Join our Discord server at: https://discord.com/invite/UUF7Zbm 

Original trailer available here:
https://youtu.be/mA9L0sycioY
